impact_cover.description: High-impact cover/KV/chapter structure with editable title and support copy.
impact_cover.design_floor: Must include a real visual field or generated object; do not leave a plain central rectangle as the final cover.

strategy_argument_cards.description: Editable argument card stack with one visual object anchor and optional short visual text asset.
strategy_argument_cards.design_floor: The visual asset must operate as the metaphor for the argument, not as detached decoration.

execution_ticket_steps.description: Editable mechanism/process steps styled as ticket or mission cards.
execution_ticket_steps.design_floor: Execution pages must include a designed object/icon panel plus editable ticket cards; no plain step list.

execution_timeline.description: Editable horizontal rollout timeline with milestone nodes.
execution_timeline.design_floor: Use a visible project-specific rhythm line and styled milestone cards instead of default timeline SmartArt.

benefit_matrix.description: Editable grid/matrix for benefits, value exchange, or rights packages.
benefit_matrix.design_floor: Tables must become a skinned matrix with hierarchy, chips, and spacing; never use default Office table styling.

data_capsules.description: Editable KPI capsule row or grouped data takeaways.

cinematic_storyboard.description: Cinematic proposal page built from a real frame or generated still, with editable title, script line, interpretation, and proposal logic.
cinematic_storyboard.design_floor: The image must act as the page's narrative evidence. Editable text should read as a designed film-treatment/proposal page, not as cards pasted over a background.

brand_argument_spread.description: Flat editorial brand-strategy spread for real proposal reasoning pages, with oversized editable claim text, structured proof points, and no shadows.
brand_argument_spread.design_floor: Must feel like a strategic brand proposal spread. Avoid card shadows, SVG glow, default bullets, and generic rounded containers.
